How to Apply
Online Information Sessions
Join us virtually here at the University of Chicago for a series of online information sessions designed to highlight our MS and PhD in Data Science programs. Hosted by faculty and staff in the Data Science Institute (DSI), we’ll discuss each track’s unique curriculum, research opportunities, admission requirements, funding, and much, much more.
Check back on our website soon for details about future information sessions.
MS in Data Science (MSDS) Application Requirements
Create your applicant portal using our online application
Submit transcripts for all previous degrees and coursework completed or in-progress
Complete the Candidate Statement, applicants will answer the following prompt:
Please discuss your academic and career objectives. Be as specific as you can about the fields in which you plan to study and your particular research interests. Beyond what is apparent from your transcripts, describe your preparation for your proposed program of study, including research projects in which you have participated.
Attach an updated resume or CV
Submit three (3) letters of recommendation (you can provide contact information for references in the applicant portal)
TOEFL or IELTS test scores are only required if needed to meet our English Language Proficiency Requirement
PhD in Data Science Application Requirements
Create your applicant portal using our online application
Complete the Data Science Supplement
PhD candidates will be asked to indicate up to three (3) areas of research interest as well as identify three (3) potential faculty advisors with whom you are interested in working with. For a full list of faculty on our Committee on Data Science (CODAS), please click here.
Submit transcripts for all previous degrees and coursework completed or in-progress
Complete the Candidate Statement, applicants will answer the following prompt:
Please discuss your academic and career objectives. Be as specific as you can about the fields in which you plan to study and your particular research interests. Beyond what is apparent from your transcripts, describe your preparation for your proposed program of study, including research projects in which you have participated.
Attach an updated resume or CV
Submit three (3) letters of recommendation (you can provide contact information for references in the applicant portal)
TOEFL or IELTS test scores are only required if needed to meet our English Language Proficiency Requirement
Application Fee
There is a $90.00 non-refundable application fee.
Standardized Test Scores
The Physical Sciences Division (PSD) does not require the GRE or other standardized test scores for admission into the MSDS or PhD programs. Applicants may choose to submit scores if they have already completed a standardized exam but it is not required that you do so.
For those who plan to submit the GRE, please be advised that it will only be considered valid if the exam was taken within five (5) years prior to the application deadline. The Educational Testing Service (ETS) institutional code for the University of Chicago is 1832.
Application Deadlines
Below are the deadlines for prospective students applying for our Fall 2027 quarter. Please note that we do not admit candidates in any other term beyond the Fall quarter. All application materials must be submitted by the dates below in order to be considered for admission.
